Use high-contrast manga advertising design with diagonal speed lines, glowing blue UI panels, white speech bubbles, thick black outlines, neon cyan highlights, red emphasis words, and dramatic perspective. No empty space.

Layout: Build one large central headline and surrounding mini-panels in a chaotic but readable collage. Include exactly 16 distinct content zones: 1 huge top-left welcome headline, 1 central main slogan, 1 central crowd/workspace scene, 1 coding support panel, 1 image-generation gallery panel, 1 video-generation panel, 1 tool-war vertical banner, 1 AI-agent automation checklist, 1 music-AI waveform panel, 1 debate/legal scales panel, 1 startup meeting panel, 1 researcher evolution panel, 1 social-media excitement strip, and 3 bottom everyday-life support cards.

Add a right vertical banner reading ツール戦国時代!! 進化のスピードがエグい!!. Add a bottom-right final proclamation reading 競争も、協力も、学びも、遊びも──全部ひっくるめて、これがAIの今だ!!. Surround everything with many smaller Japanese-style captions, exclamation bubbles, tags, arrows, badges, and UI labels; they should look authentic but may be tiny and partially unreadable.

Subject details: Central scene shows a crowded modern co-working hall filled with excited young anime creators, office workers, students, researchers, and startup founders using laptops, tablets, holographic screens, phones, and AI dashboards. Many human faces should be intentionally anonymized with soft square blur masks, while hair, poses, clothing, and devices remain visible. Add multiple cute white-and-blue robot mascots with black oval faces and glowing cyan eyes; include exactly 4 robots: one large robot at top left, one small robot beside the automation checklist, one tiny robot in the social-media strip, and one small robot in the elderly-support card.

Panel details and exact counted elements: The image-generation panel contains exactly 1 large fantasy castle preview and 5 thumbnail variations below it. The video-generation panel contains exactly 1 large cyberpunk anime girl preview and 6 small thumbnails below it. The AI-agent panel contains exactly 5 checklist items with checkmarks, suggesting research, data analysis, document creation, email sending, and scheduling. The music-AI panel contains exactly 1 large music-note icon, 1 waveform display, and 4 playback controls. The debate/legal panel contains exactly 1 balance-scale icon and 2 debating figures. The social-media area contains exactly 3 metric badges with heart, repost, and comment icons, showing large numbers such as 12.8K, 5.6K, and 3.2K, plus floating hearts and stars. The bottom strip contains exactly 4 everyday-support cards: translation/travel chat, AI learning support, health management support, and elderly monitoring/consultation.

Visual style: Polished anime illustration mixed with UI mockup, infographic, and manga advertisement aesthetics. Use saturated electric blues, blacks, whites, red accents, yellow lightbulb highlights, and glossy screen reflections. Fonts should be bold Japanese display fonts with heavy outlines, drop shadows, and slanted dynamic emphasis. Add motion streaks, comic bursts, arrows, stickers, holographic overlays, browser windows, code snippets, waveform graphs, data charts, smartphone screens, notification icons, and social media UI.

Constraints: Keep the poster extremely information-dense and energetic. Use Japanese typography throughout the design, but prioritize the five specified headline texts. Layout: Use exactly 8 rounded rectangular content cards plus 1 long bottom slogan banner. Arrange them in a neat grid. Left side contains one large hero card occupying about half the width and most of the height. Right side contains four smaller information cards in a 2×2 grid. Bottom left contains one small card. Bottom center/right contains one long horizontal slogan banner. Keep generous spacing and consistent rounded corners.

Main hero card: Show a softly lit tabletop scene with a clear glass cup of pale yellow-green tea in the upper right, visible floating Longjing tea leaves, and a small white porcelain dish piled with flat green tea leaves in the lower center. Add blurred green plant shadows in the background. Text on the left: small pill label with a leaf icon and 中国十大名茶之一; large dark-green Chinese title 龙井茶; smaller English subtitle “Longjing Tea”; short description in Chinese: “中国十大名茶之一，以扁平挺秀、清香鲜爽著称。” At the bottom of this hero card, include exactly 3 feature icon blocks: 1) leaf icon, label “历史悠久”, sublabel “千年传承”; 2) mountain icon, label “匠心工艺”, sublabel “传统炒制”; 3) teacup icon, label “清雅之味”, sublabel “自然本真”. Add a small location pill at the lower right with a pin icon and text “浙江·杭州·西湖”.

Right information cards: Create exactly 4 cards. Card 1, top middle: “产地” with a small pagoda/temple line icon in a circle, text “主要产于浙江杭州西湖一带，西湖龙井最为知名。” and faint misty mountain scenery along the bottom. Card 2, top right: “特点” with a dark green circular leaf icon and exactly 4 listed rows separated by dotted lines: “外形扁平挺直”, “色泽嫩绿光润”, “香气清高鲜爽”, “滋味鲜醇甘润”, each with a small matching line icon. Card 3, lower middle: “风味” with a teacup icon, text “豆香、栗香与清新的嫩香并存，口感柔和，回甘细腻。” and a pale botanical leaf illustration in the lower right. Card 4, lower right: “冲泡建议” with a teapot icon, text “水温 80–85°C | 茶水比例 1:50 | 可用玻璃杯或盖碗冲泡。” At the bottom of this card include exactly 3 small brewing icons and labels: thermometer “80–85°C”, water drop “1:50”, teacup “玻璃杯/盖碗”.

Bottom left card: “等级与采摘” with a leaf icon badge, text “以春茶为佳，芽叶细嫩，明前茶尤受欢迎。” and one rectangular photo inset on the right showing fresh bright green tea shoots growing outdoors with shallow depth of field.

Bottom slogan banner: A long pale green banner with subtle tea-leaf texture. Center the large dark-green Chinese slogan 鲜 · 香 · 甘. On the right add smaller text “一杯龙井，品味江南春意”, a delicate flowing line drawing of tea leaves, and a tiny vertical square seal containing “茶”.

prompt_en: Create a vintage fantasy travel postcard poster for BEACON HOLLOW, designed like a large-letter souvenir postcard from the 1950s–1960s. The composition is a single richly detailed horizontal scene with heavily weathered paper texture, rounded postcard corners, faded inks, creases, scratches, foxing, and worn edges. Across the top and center, huge dimensional block letters spell “BEACON HOLLOW” in classic retro postcard style, with warm cream outlines and red-brown extruded shadows; each letter contains miniature painted scenic vignettes of the destination, including alpine peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. In the upper left, hand-painted script text reads “GREETINGS FROM” in dark red. In the upper right, include a circular black postal cancellation stamp reading “BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT,” overlapping a vintage postage stamp labeled “BEACON HOLLOW” and “CREATIVE RETREAT” with “7c,” depicting a moonlit mountain and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Beneath the title, place a small curved ribbon banner reading a magejosh destination with tiny compass-star ornaments. The main background should show a majestic golden-hour mountain valley with a winding river, distant snowy peaks, dense evergreen forests, and on the right a large timber-and-stone fantasy lodge perched on a cliff, warmly lit from within, with stairs descending the slope. Scatter subtle magical blue lights and faint arcane circular glyphs around the lodge and foreground for a worldbuilding-meets-magic atmosphere. In the lower left, place exactly 3 foreground desk objects: a dark ceramic mug with a compass emblem, an open sketchbook spread, and a fountain pen resting diagonally across the pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled “Campaign Ideas” and lists 3 bullets: “The Forgotten Vale,” “Clockwork Pilgrims,” and “Echoes of the First Light,” with a small castle drawing below; the right page shows a tree illustration and the handwritten text “Beery world Hollow.” Across the lower center, add an old illustrated map spread out on the table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn cartographic details. In the lower right, place exactly 5 more foreground elements: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase “Ideas Become Legends,” a cluster of 4 polyhedral dice, a rustic wooden signpost with 4 directional slats reading “STORY,” “GAME DESIGN,” “WORLD BUILDING,” and “AI FOR CREATORS,” a glowing glass lamp or tube device, and a nearby floating arcane target-like sigil. Add a pinned handwritten note left of center on aged paper reading, “Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — magejosh” in blue cursive. Use painterly illustration with high detail, nostalgic Americana postcard design, fantasy concept art sensibility, warm sunset lighting, muted teal sky, sepia aging, and an inviting creative-retreat mood.\

Centered composition with a tall alien emperor standing behind a massive circular command table, viewed from slightly below to make the figure feel imposing and godlike. The emperor wears ornate black and gunmetal biomechanical armor with sharp layered pauldrons, engraved metallic filigree, a long dark cloak, and a regal elongated helmet-crown. The face is mostly obscured in shadow, giving a mysterious, intimidating presence. One large clawed hand rests prominently on the glowing table in the foreground. The setting is the bridge of a colossal starship or throne room, with two curved panoramic windows framing outer space. Outside the windows are 8 visible spacecraft total: 4 on the left side and 4 on the right side, including several large battleships and smaller escort vessels. A huge planet fills much of the left background, while the right background shows a purple-blue nebula and starfield. Two secondary alien officers are seated in the mid-background, 1 on the left and 1 on the right, each at glowing futuristic control consoles. The color palette is deep black, steel gray, indigo, violet, and cold blue, with dramatic rim lighting, glossy metallic reflections, and dense atmospheric shadows. The layout should feel like a premium blockbuster poster: a centered top tagline in small uppercase text reading INTELLIGENCE. DOMINION. DESTINY. THE GALAXY BOWS TO NONE., the giant title near the bottom in elegant spaced serif capitals with the words EMPIRE on the first line and OF THE VOID below it, with the letter O stylized as a glowing black-hole eclipse. Beneath that, add a glowing imperial trident-like emblem centered above the release line COMING SOON. At the very bottom, include a dense strip of tiny production credits in authentic movie-poster typography. Main scene: A sandy beach at sunset with the sun low near the horizon over the ocean. The sea glows with orange reflections and small waves roll onto shore. In the far background, include a rocky point with a small lighthouse and low coastal trees. Add exactly 3 seabirds in the sky: 1 large blurred bird at upper right, 1 small bird near the center horizon, and 1 small bird at left above the waves. Add a single pale seashell in the lower right foreground.

Characters: Include exactly 2 human figures. On the lower left, a young woman in a loose white sleeveless summer dress sits on the sand in profile, hair tied in a messy bun, writing or sketching in a notebook on her lap with a pen. Her face is turned downward and should have minimal recognizable detail, slightly soft or obscured. On the right, a young man in a dark T-shirt and knee-length shorts stands barefoot on the wet sand facing the ocean and sunset, shown from behind/side, contemplative and still. Long shadows stretch across the sand.

Typography and layout: Use elegant vertical Chinese calligraphy in white down the center of the poster for the main title: 同一片海，終會遇見你. Beneath it, add a small handwritten English subtitle in white: Same Sea, Same Time. At the top edge, place exactly 3 small actor-name text groups spaced left, center, and right: 陳意涵　胡宇威　劉俊謙. Add exactly 3 small Chinese quote blocks placed around the sky and beach: one on the upper left, one near the right of the title above the standing man, and one on the lower left above the seated woman. Use delicate, readable, poster-style Chinese text.

Bottom credits: Add a centered emotional tagline above the release date: 無論你去到哪裡，我總會在同一片海邊，遇見。. Below it, set the release line clearly in spaced white text: 2024 夏日上映. Add one line of director/writer credits and a dense row of tiny production logos and billing text along the very bottom, like a professional film poster.
